Each group has one simple fictional article row with checkbox, title “设计笔记” or “技术记录” or “每周精选” and a gray URL, no personal handles. Fourth website group “unknown.example” has NO category chip, NO unknown or other tag. Show secondary text under card “未识别的网站不显示分类”. Footer selected count “已选 0 项”.
